Joseph Jacobs, Indian Fairy Tales.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/joseph-jacobs/indian-fairy-tales

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Joseph Jacobs, the author, died 1916.

First publication of the text used: 1892 (SE colophon: 'Indian Fairy Tales was published in 1892 by Joseph Jacobs.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1892, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 1987.
- Country of origin: every person whose words are in the text died in 1916 or earlier (the last to die, Joseph Jacobs, in 1916), so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.

They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
